basics.name: Igor Rybakov
basics.label: Senior Fullstack Engineer (JavaScript, Python, Rust)
basics.summary: Senior Fullstack Engineer with 8+ years of experience building and scaling complex applications in GIS, finance, and B2B sectors. Proven expert in frontend performance, reducing map rendering time from 3.5s to 200ms for 100k+ data points. As a sole technical owner, built a full-stack B2B platform from scratch, including CRM, AI pipelines, and infrastructure, cutting costs by over 50%. Formerly a Lead Frontend Engineer mentoring a team of five.

work.name: VS Industrie GmbH
work.summary: Sole responsibility for development and operation of Spairtech, a technical platform for an industrial equipment distributor. Work type: Freelance
highlights: Acted as the sole technical owner, designing and building the 'Spairtech' B2B platform from the ground up, replacing fragmented legacy systems and manual Excel workflows.
Developed a full-stack CRM and public-facing e-commerce catalog using React, Next.js, and NestJS, integrating customer management, orders, SIP telephony, and marketing campaigns (email and calls).

Built three AI systems: a knowledge-base-driven assistant helping managers use and configure the platform, including forms, dashboards, and company settings; AI crawlers combining public web research with internal database data to propose or apply product card updates; and a pilot voice AI operator integrating streaming speech recognition, interruption handling, LLM-driven dialogue, speech synthesis, and CRM reporting.
Overhauled the company's infrastructure: decommissioned a legacy PBX, consolidated servers, and replaced OpenVPN with WireGuard, cutting monthly infrastructure costs by over 50%.

work.name: Big3 / A.PRO
work.summary: Development of an enterprise GIS platform for environmental operations and logistics.
highlights: Promoted to Lead Frontend Engineer, mentoring and managing a team of 5 developers through performance reviews, task allocation, and code quality leadership.

Drastically improved GIS platform performance by re-architecting the map rendering logic, cutting the display time for 100,000+ markers from 3.5 seconds to under 200ms, and cut regression and progression critical bugs by over 55% (from 61 in Q4 2024 to 27 in Q1 2025) in the following six months.
Developed a client-side cache using Rust/WASM and IndexedDB, which reduced dashboard CPU usage from 120% to 80%.
Architected and built a reusable, component-based UI system and a unified integration layer for geoservice APIs, standardizing development and accelerating feature delivery across teams.
Eliminated a major development bottleneck by replacing hardcoded form configurations with a dynamic admin panel, saving an estimated 2-3 hours of dev and QA time per task.

work.name: Societe Generale
work.summary: MVP dashboard for monitoring currencies and stock market indices.
highlights: Developed and delivered an MVP for a currency and stock market monitoring dashboard, enabling traders to use configurable layouts and workspaces.
Built a flexible subscription engine allowing users to create custom alerts based on user-defined formulas and triggers.
Engineered the core UI with modular, reusable components, setting the foundation for future feature expansion.

work.name: SmartDeal
work.summary: Frontend development for a real estate transaction automation product.
highlights: As the sole frontend developer, owned the entire user-facing application for a real estate transaction platform, which was later acquired by industry leaders CIAN and PSB.
Built a dynamic document generation system supporting 17+ document types with customizable templates, automating a critical part of the transaction workflow.
Implemented SMS-based electronic signing and real-time application status tracking, significantly improving user experience and transaction speed.

work.name: LANIT-TERCOM
work.summary: Development of data visualization and GIS platforms.
highlights: Contributed to a data visualization platform using Angular and NgRx.
Added end-to-end testing with Cypress.
Developed a GIS date-handling module for planning, visualization and analytics.

work.name: Freelance
work.summary: MVP application with an interactive map for a civic campaign in the Komi Republic.
highlights: Built an MVP in three days with an interactive map, voting and feedback; deployed ASP.NET Core, MS SQL and Angular/Ionic, then handed the system to the customer for launch.

work.name: ETAI
work.summary: Development of an EMR/EHR platform and eTIME, a project management application.
highlights: Built interactive SVG anatomy maps with predefined regions and medical labels, replacing manual drawing and labeling by clinicians.
Developed a C# scanning service on .NET Framework 4.5: a WebSocket devices command listed scanners, while scan with a device ID returned a base64 image to the browser.
Developed SQL scripts for updating medication data and ICD-10/ICD-11 classifications.
Built the eTIME frontend from scratch, including registration, boards, tasks, comments, profiles and workspaces.
Implemented task update synchronization through WebSocket/SignalR and workspace onboarding through email invitations.
